description: This file contains Python source code for internal PyTorch dispatch mechanisms, including functions for managing overloads, dispatchers, and tensor metadata checks, as well as context managers for functionalization and cross-referencing.

classes.name: Lit
classes.description: A simple class for wrapping and representing string literals.

methods.name: all_py_loaded_overloads
methods.description: Generator yielding all Python-loaded operator overloads in torch._ops.

methods.name: suspend_functionalization
methods.description: Context manager to suspend and re-enable functionalization in torch.

methods.name: check_tensor_metadata_matches
methods.description: Checks if two tensors have matching size, dtype, and strides.

methods.name: check_metadata_matches
methods.description: Checks if two objects' flattened tree structures have matching tensor metadata.

methods.name: make_crossref_functionalize
methods.description: Creates a handler for functionalizing a specific operator overload.

methods.name: enable_crossref_functionalize
methods.description: Context manager to enable cross-reference functionalization, patching dispatch cache.
